title: Fast Matrix Multiplication · Strassen / AlphaTensor Frontier
tagline: Exact bilinear rank over the integers and GF(2)
question: How few scalar products suffice to multiply two small matrices exactly?
description: Prove Strassen’s seven-product construction and the tensor-product composition rule. Then certify smaller integer schemes for 3×3 by 3×4 and 3×4 by 4×5, or improve on AlphaTensor’s 47 products for 4×4 over GF(2).
verdict: Open for integer and GF(2) rank certificates.
